verdicts.reason: Both break the original's lockup in the same ways. The logo sits on the right after the NEW VIDEO pill, so the brand is no longer top-left and neither the logo nor the pill lines up with the headline's left edge (x≈55). The shoe also hangs off-centre from the green disc instead of sitting on it, so the product badge is lost. In A the green disc is cut off by the right and bottom edges, and the shoe plus disc crowd the bottom-right corner while a lot of empty purple sits below the subtitle. B keeps the disc inside the canvas and holds the product group together better, but its text stack is tighter (pill and logo row nearly touching the headline, subtitle jammed under it) and the bottom margin is uneven.
